move.text:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We are pleased to confirm the requested lead time of 42 days. In response to your target, we can revise our offer to €15.60 per unit under these terms. Thus, our offer is a price of €15.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days, delivery EXW. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

To consider further price adjustments, we would need to discuss a potential increase in the order volume. Which volume can you commit to?

Please note that material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. Furthermore, our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
